import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# File paths
ref_file = r"C:\Users\sandeeppawar\Downloads\aida-eval\data\file_generation_en\reference\FG_143\2025 Xijiao Shareholder List Summary Table_res.xlsx"
pred_file = r"C:\Users\sandeeppawar\Downloads\aida-eval\runs\aida-ctrl\work\FG_143\2025 Xijiao Shareholder List Summary Table.xlsx"

# Read data
ref_df = pd.read_excel(ref_file, sheet_name='Sheet1')
pred_df = pd.read_excel(pred_file, sheet_name='Sheet1')

# Check numeric columns
numeric_cols = ['Number of people', 'Active', 'Retired']

print("=== Numeric Column Comparison ===")
for col in numeric_cols:
    # Compare values (handling NaN)
    ref_vals = ref_df[col]
    pred_vals = pred_df[col]
    
    # Check if equal (considering NaN as equal)
    are_equal = []
    for i in range(len(ref_vals)):
        r = ref_vals.iloc[i]
        p = pred_vals.iloc[i]
        if pd.isna(r) and pd.isna(p):
            are_equal.append(True)
        elif pd.isna(r) or pd.isna(p):
            are_equal.append(False)
        else:
            are_equal.append(np.isclose(r, p, rtol=1e-6, atol=1e-6))
    
    all_match = all(are_equal)
    num_mismatches = sum(not x for x in are_equal)
    
    print(f"\n{col}:")
    print(f"  All match: {all_match}")
    print(f"  Mismatches: {num_mismatches}")
    
    if num_mismatches > 0:
        print(f"  Showing mismatches:")
        for i, match in enumerate(are_equal):
            if not match:
                print(f"    Row {i}: REF={ref_vals.iloc[i]} vs PRED={pred_vals.iloc[i]}")

# Overall summary
print("\n=== Overall Summary ===")
print(f"Shape matches: {ref_df.shape == pred_df.shape}")
print(f"Columns match: {list(ref_df.columns) == list(pred_df.columns)}")
print(f"Unit Name column matches: False (all 28 rows differ)")
print(f"Number of people matches: {all(are_equal)}")  # From last iteration
